   white space, is exactly the 25 code points of Unicode's `White_Space`
   property: U+0009 to U+000D, U+0020, U+0085, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000 to
   U+200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+202F, U+205F and U+3000; no other character is
   white space, whatever a language's own operation counts, and `strip(v)`
   below removes these from both ends of `v`.

v given and strip(v) = "" => v is read as not given: missing when it is
required, absent when it is optional   -- A02-1
A project with a display name of three spaces is refused.

A Customer's name and an access request text with spaces around them are
   stored as written; a room name, a Customer's name and an access request
   text of spaces only are each refused and nothing changes.
judgement.divergence: An implementation using the declared 25-code-point set refuses a required value consisting of U+0085 and retains U+001C as present, whereas an implementation using its language's native whitespace operation can classify either differently while still satisfying the stated ASCII-space Required tests; the caller observes acceptance instead of refusal or refusal instead of acceptance.
judgement.why: A02-1 now depends on an exact closed set, but its Required tests specify only ordinary spaces and therefore do not say what must be shown for the added non-ASCII members and excluded language-specific whitespace characters.
options: Require an exact assertion that `WHITE_SPACE_CODE_POINTS` contains precisely the listed code points plus behavioral tests for required, optional and padded values.
Exercise every listed member and representative excluded characters behaviorally.
Retain only the existing ASCII-space examples.
consequences: Without exact included-and-excluded coverage, generated code can pass every stated Required test while violating A02's closed-set guarantee.

witness.initial: Registry is running with an active project-create form, and the owner supplies a required display name consisting solely of U+0085 or solely of U+001C.
events: The owner submits the project creation through the owner interface with the chosen display name.
Registry classifies the required value as blank or present and answers the request.
outcomes: Using the specified set, U+0085 is refused as missing and U+001C is retained as present.
Using the implementation language's native whitespace operation, U+0085 or U+001C may receive the opposite classification while all stated Required tests still pass.
witness.observer: The owner submitting the request sees acceptance instead of refusal or refusal instead of acceptance.
basis:
Registry serves simple server-rendered HTML forms over its own operations
(vNext §5): the project list, creating a project, reading and correcting its
card (customer and object included), choosing the working project, archiving
with confirmation, and the customer, audit and switch-request views the
primary actions need.

A required value given as an empty string or as white space only is missing,
   and the action is refused as for a missing value: a project's display name
   and its object's address (R0-45), a Customer's name and kind (Primary
   actions), a room's name (R0-10), a session's access request text.

author_guidance: Before editing, identify the decision's owning state from the phase purpose, question_scope and layer obligations, then choose a disposition for each topic that awaits one.
fixed: repair a decision the owning state must make; do not add later-layer implementation choices merely to close a topic. Record the fix commit and review the changed text once.

carried: name the receiving layer and use --what to preserve the choice, its options and consequences, and the required guarantee every option must keep. Decide any guarantee owned here before carrying its execution onward.
accepted: explain why the remaining choice is permitted. Bring an unresolved product choice to the owner with its options and consequences; absence of a quoted requirement does not decide it.
contradiction and standard_violation take no disposition: repair the offending text in its owning state and review the change. Deterministic transition findings must also close through their checks.
State 2: decide required results and constraints, including necessary refusal precedence; carry test mechanisms, exact contracts and deployment procedures to their owners.
